site_or_subject: Registration of virtual currency mining facilities as large flexible loads (SB 1929, PURA §39.360; 16 TAC §25.114)
operator: Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT)
record: SB 1929 (88th Legislature, effective September 1, 2023) added PURA 'Sec. 39.360. LARGE FLEXIBLE LOAD REGISTRATION', requiring operators of virtual currency mining facilities taking retail service in the ERCOT region to register when 'the facility requires a total load of more than 75 megawatts' and 'the facility load is interruptible', including location and anticipated demand over five years (Senate bill analysis). The PUCT implemented it in Project No. 56962 as 16 TAC §25.114 (proposed in the Texas Register of 13 September 2024; order adopting signed November 2024). The rule applies where total load exceeds 75 MW and the 'interruptible load equals 10 percent or more of the actual or anticipated annual peak demand'; facilities already in service had to 'register no later than February 1, 2025'. The adoption order states registration information 'will be collected via an internal-facing online tool that will not be accessible to the public.' The PUCT's virtual currency mining web page describes the requirement and lists no registered facilities.

site_or_subject: ANDE tariff group covering cryptoasset mining (Grupo de Consumo Intensivo Especial, Pliego de Tarifas N° 21)
operator: Administración Nacional de Electricidad (ANDE)
record: ANDE Resolución P/Nº 47191 (Asunción, 5 December 2022) created the special intensive-consumption group, covering activities 'incluyendo minería de criptoactivos, blockchain, token y data centers' and supplies 'cuyo factor de carga mensual sea igual o superior al 80% (ochenta por ciento), 2 (dos) veces', with tariffs in US dollars, e.g. 220 kV: 'Potencia reservada en punta de carga USD/kW mes 4,64' and 'Energía en punta de carga USD/kWh 0,03277'; 66 kV: USD 6.38/kW-month and 'USD/kWh 0,03421'; 23 kV supplies capped at 'Potencia reservada máxima en punta de carga: 6.000 kW' (substation) and 2,000 kW (line). Resolución P/Nº 47885 (14 June 2023) modified items 4.11.5 and 4.12.8 ('GRUPO DE CONSUMO INTENSIVO ESPECIAL') of Tariff Schedule No. 21, including the load-factor test 'factor de carga mensual superior o igual al 80%'. Resolución P/Nº 49238 (Asunción, 26 de junio de 2024) approves 'la actualización de las Tarifas de Energía Eléctrica' for supplies of the Grupo de Consumo Intensivo Especial at 220 kV, 66 kV and 23 kV, replacing the tariffs of Article 2 of P/Nº 47191: 220 kV 'Potencia reservada en punta de carga USD/kW mes 5,27' and 'Energía en punta de carga USD/kWh 0,03725'; 66 kV 'USD/kW mes 7,02' and 'USD/kWh 0,03765'. The 2024 resolution does not mention crypto assets; the group's definition including 'minería de criptoactivos' is in P/Nº 47191.
